purpose: Canonical audit of current Academy sprites and scene rasters, explicit deprecations, and missing cast expression variants.

policy.active: Present raster with an approved-runtime or review-candidate/runtime-preview ASSET-USAGE verdict and at least one runtime home.
policy.orphaned: Present, non-deprecated raster without runtime authorization; retained for review and never silently promoted.
policy.deprecated: Explicitly rejected or superseded raster; it may be absent and is never runtime-authorized.
policy.missingExpressionVariant: Undelivered slot in the canonical 28-character by 3-angle by 7-expression matrix.
policy.offMatrix: Delivered sprite outside the canonical expression matrix; retained state is reported but it does not fill a matrix slot.
policy.deletion: This audit never deletes, moves, or mutates Academy raster files.
